mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Reddan Soccer Park with a current temperature of 58 degrees. We are looking at an overnight low of 51 degrees with no rain in the forecast, under the light of a waxing gibbous moon.

City of Verona offices will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for Thanksgiving. Trash and recycling pickup for Thursday is delayed until Friday, and the recycling center will be closed.
We have plenty of fun ahead, starting with Live Music at Bailey's Run today. Tomorrow, you can catch more live music at Paddy Mac's, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday.
Regarding recent reports, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot resulted in a driver being arrested for O W I.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's. The store is currently open until 10:30 PM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a treat before they close for the evening.
